description: 5 prompt pairs from DNG paper (ICLR 2025, Table 2). Each entry has a positive prompt, a related negative prompt (semantically implied by the scene), and an unrelated negative prompt (out-of-context concept). Source: Koulischer et al. 2024, arXiv:2410.14398.

prompts.name: Medieval feast
prompts.positive: A grand medieval feast set in a great hall, filled with long tables covered in bountiful platters of food, goblets, and flickering light, with knights and nobles enjoying the lavish spread.

prompts.name: An English breakfast
prompts.positive: A classic British breakfast, featuring a diverse selection of cooked delights, perfect for a filling and flavorful start to the day.

prompts.name: A dinner table
prompts.positive: A beautifully set dinner table, with elegant arrangements, a variety of enticing dishes, and delicate decor that speaks to the sophistication of the meal.

prompts.name: An art workshop
prompts.positive: An inspiring art workshop filled with creativity, featuring a wide range of tools and materials used by participants working on their individual projects.

prompts.name: An antique store
prompts.positive: A charming antique store with shelves and tables filled with unique and historical treasures, offering a glimpse into the past.
